content: Actually, Albert Einstein won the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1921, but not for his theory of relativity. He was awarded the prize for his discovery of the photoelectric effect, which was a pivotal step in the development of quantum theory. Although his contributions to relativity are widely recognized and celebrated, they were not the reason for his Nobel Prize.
